retrievalProfile.description: A centered, glowing blue humanoid head with an oversized cranium and soft airbrushed gradients, topped with geometric, thin-line futuristic typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical, stylized humanoid face with a large, bulbous upper head and narrow chin, rendered in smooth cyan-to-navy gradients with a soft internal glow, positioned against a dark blue background.
coreVisualRelationships: The head is perfectly centered and occupies the majority of the vertical space.
Typography is placed at the extreme top edge, spanning the width of the head.
Soft highlights on the brow and nose contrast with deep blue shadows in the eye sockets.
The color palette is monochromatic blue with subtle pinkish-white highlights.
coreInvariants: Symmetrical humanoid facial structure with exaggerated cranium width.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large centered portrait, filling approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing bridge of the nose and the brow ridge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top typography down to the eyes, then following the smooth curves of the jawline.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep navy blue void surrounding the head, creating a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Navy blue background and deep shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan and light blue for the primary form and glow.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the typography and sharpest facial highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the glowing face and dark background; low saturation overall, leaning into cool tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif with circular and linear motifs.
letterConstructionRules: Horizontal crossbars are often replaced by arcs or stylized breaks.
Letters like 'A' and 'M' use wide, angular stances.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' features a curved crossbar that mimics the top of the head.
The 'M' is constructed from two overlapping or adjacent V-shapes.

composition.relationshipToImage: separated by space at the top

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single stylized display face to maintain sci-fi minimalism.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a centered airbrushed portrait of a blue humanoid with a large bulbous head and soft glowing features on a dark navy background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of thin, white, geometric uppercase text at the top, using wide tracking and circular letterforms.

verificationChecks: Is the typography thin and geometric?
Are the gradients smooth without visible brush strokes?
Is the color palette strictly limited to blues and white?

mustRedesign: Exact letter-to-letter spacing of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the thin weight.
Check that the glow does not wash out the facial features.
Verify the symmetry of the humanoid head.
Confirm the background is a clean, dark gradient.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered airbrushed humanoid + dark navy void + top-aligned geometric thin-line typography.
